goal: Agent memory retention review: how long memory is kept, and how it is deleted on request.
use: Agent memory retention review: how long memory is kept, and how it is deleted on request. Use when memory is kept across sessions or users.

steps.note: List the retention rules. Each kind of memory and how long it is kept.
Check the deletion. Confirm a user's memories can be found and removed.
Check the copies. Flag memory copied into logs, backups or analytics.
Check the expiry. Flag memory with no expiry at all.
Report. Each kind with its retention, the deletion path and the gap.
